temporal_scope: Two exact January/July2022snapshots,not seasonal means or annual extrema.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear transverse strips on consecutive native latitude columns only. Native minimum supported span retained where a boundary is censored.
surface_gate_interpretation: Original0.05m/s surface selection is below0.1m/s primary cutoff; it does not force the primary top to the surface or establish a physical surface layer.
minimum_span_interpretation: Minimum support is conditional on original contiguous piecewise-linear signed-component model definition. It is not a physical named-current thickness bound. A single supported level gives zero minimum support,not zero thickness or absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket conditional geometry scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual bounds.
axis_anchor_interpretation: Original model-selected axis proxies only;one gate-edge case keeps null anchor and original candidate diagnosis. No source-window/core/date/branch replacement or between-section interpolation.
interpretation: Partial model-component section geometry,not flow-normal width,physical body/current bottom,whole-route depth or water volume. Distinct snapshot/section cases are not additive water volume.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original source scope and qualifiers retained.
run_note: Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.
